title: Tibetan Buddhist dark retreats

tellings.quote: where some practitioners will go into isolation for uh a year or more at a time living just in a dark cell

plain: Some Tibetan Buddhist practitioners go into isolation for a year or more at a time, living alone in a completely dark cell, as the researcher of the mind and paranormal Jeffrey Mishlove tells Jesse Michels. He mentions it in passing, as something generally known, while talking about altered states and the mind's hidden abilities.
